facts.business: Garware Marine Industries Limited is engaged in the repair and maintenance of vessels.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Company has not recognised Expected Credit Loss (ECL) provision in respect of trade receivables outstanding for a period exceeding three years amounting to Rs. 355.15 Lakhs, as required under Ind AS 109.

key_risks: Non-recognition of Expected Credit Loss (ECL) provision on trade receivables outstanding for over three years amounting to Rs. 355.15 Lakhs, leading to uncertainty over recoverability and financial statement impact.
